body.x: Liquid Image(www.liquidimageco.com) introduced "Ego LS Camera" at CES Unveiled, a pre-show of CES 2015 which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.Ego LS Camera is a multi-functional camera that pairs with a variety of wireless features like wi-fi and Bluetooth. It allows fast live streaming with XLTE through Verizon 4G LTE network. It integrates streaming metadata from other periphperal connected devices such as biometrics, geolocation, and other sensor information.

Held annually in January and owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), CES 2015 is the world's largest IT and consumer electronics exhibition to see the latest global trends in consumer electronics industry in one spot.Globally recognized for its record in the number of published articles for CES, AVING News has been sending its reporters to CES every year to deliver the fastest and freshest news on the spot.
